value.rationale: The canonical pair of dual strong-connective distributivity laws has an exact natural satisfaction invariant in every standard finite MV chain. Individually each has positive limiting density 1/6, whereas the simultaneous density vanishes at the sharp rate 5/n; the joint locus has a complete six-piece description and uniform 3n interior-section count. These are substantive quantitative statements, not merely a normalized counterexample.
